name: Trade Offer
meaning: A man in a suit with hands steepled proposes a deal under a "TRADE OFFER" banner. For a lopsided or absurd exchange.
when_to_use: text1 = what I receive (under "i receive:"). text2 = what you receive (under "you receive:"). text3 = optional, extra line at the bottom. A wildly unfair trade is the joke.
baked_in_text: The image already has the banner "TRADE OFFER" (with warning signs) and the labels "i receive:" and "you receive:". Captions only fill in the items.
